units: pixels at PPU 16; origin top-left, y grows downward (Unity: worldY = -y/16)
notes: Trail uses the base (Camp) palette: reuse Camp/Ground and Camp/Trees unchanged.
Depth darkness: world-space gradient from x=800 (0) to the east edge (0.42 black-teal #060e16); spawn fireflies more as it darkens.

Layout: one main trail (paths[0]) with six side branches (paths[1..6]) to training grounds 1-6, a rest spur (paths[7]) and the secret spur (paths[8]); branch forks are listed in branches[] with a Signpost at each.
Hedges: Bush_* along both main-trail sides every 9px at 24-32px offset, opened where a branch leaves; Hedge_2..4 are pre-composed runs to place faster.
Boss arena posts: Palisade_Post_* ring open to the west.
